reviews.title: Christmas gift
reviews.comment: I got this for my gamer grandson and he loves it!!
reviews.author: Debbie t.

reviews.title: Not viable for use.
reviews.comment: GPU works as expected, aside from the fan. The fan is stuck at 100%, which is 4700 rpm and extremely loud. No software apps allow me to alter the speed or mode of the fan as they should.
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.title: Good for Nvidia 3-D gaming
reviews.comment: I paid a bit extra for this one to use for a 3-D gaming. I’ve had it for about a month now and it seems to work as advertised. I tended to distrust refurbished GPU sellers, but this one seems to be good.
reviews.author: Peter Schreiber

reviews.title: Trustworthy Vendor
reviews.comment: After about 80 hours of use, no visible artifacts, in task manager and bios the card says that it is indeed a 2080 ti, usually vendors like these are untrustworthy, but I’m very, very pleased with my purchase.
reviews.author: Kindle Customer
